{{Quote|Remember that some of the greatest Mandalores were born or grew up far from our homeworld. Mandalore the Binder was born the son of a rug weaver on Harswee ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|Tor Vizsla, ''Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad''|<ref name="BHC" />}}
'''Harswee''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] celestial body located in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|ruler]] known as [[Mandalore the Binder]] [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Harswee, and [[Carpet/Legends|carpets]] from its looms were used to decorate the Mandalorian [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']].

==Description==
Harswee was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="BHC" /> located in the [[Harswee system/Legends|Harswee system]], a part of the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TransHydian" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was located far from [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]],<ref name="BHC" /> the Mandalore [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that served as the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Mandalore_the_Binder-BHC.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Mandalore the Binder was born on Harswee.]]
At some point, Harswee was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by Mandalorian people, and the celestial body became an enclave of the Mandalorian culture. An individual was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to a [[Unidentified rug weaver|rug weaver]] on Harswee and eventually became one of the greatest [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalores]], leaders of the Mandalorian people, specifically coming to be known as [[Mandalore the Binder]].<ref name="BHC" /> [[Carpet/Legends|Carpets]] from the looms of Harswee were used to decorate hallways aboard the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] of [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of Mandalore.<ref name="Incredible">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref>

Mandalore the Binder's origin on Harswee was noted in ''[[Ba'jurne Kyr'tsad Mando'ad]]'', a manifesto of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] Mandalorian splinter group. The document was supposedly [[Author/Legends|written]] by the movement's [[Secret Mandalore|leader]], [[Tor Vizsla]]&mdash;although the Death Watch's opponent [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] doubted its authenticity&mdash;and was eventually included in the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'' by Jango's [[Gender/Legends|son]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harswee was introduced in the [[2011]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Incredible" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Harswee [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square O-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
